title: Part-time Counsellor (on Contract Basis)
organization: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
summary: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is inviting online applications for one Part-time Counsellor position on a contract basis at its office in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai. Candidates with a post-graduate degree in Clinical Psychology and relevant experience are required to apply through the online portal by December 15, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess a post-graduate degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognized University or Institution.
Must have a minimum of two years of post-qualification experience in Clinical Psychology.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official SEBI website and navigate to the Careers section or access the direct online application link.
Fill out the mandatory online application form completely and accurately.
Submit the application online on or before December 15, 2026, as offline applications will not be considered.
